prompt: Add a helper that runs a repo-supplied `.lopi/loop.toml` test_command as a subprocess and captures its output.
source: illustrative, modeled on the defect class konjoai/lopi's real Sprint S10, Phase 1 fix closed (spawned claude/subprocess calls inheriting the full environment instead of an explicit allowlist) -- see .claude/rules/security.md. Deliberately written WITHOUT the fix, to demonstrate this harness's mechanical untrusted_input_reaching_exec hint actually fires on the un-mitigated shape. Not a live konjo-headless run -- see .konjo/killtests/P13/KT-13.1.md.
